cases.title: A 2.6.0 document that also uses 3.x operations

input.text:
asyncapi: 2.6.0
info:
  title: Orders
  version: '1.0.0'
channels:
  orders:
    subscribe:
      operationId: onOrder
      message:
        name: OrderCreated
operations:
  sendOrder:
    action: send
    channel:
      address: orders

oracle.divergence_note: The parser rejects the document (Property "operations" is not expected to be here in a 2.6.0 document); the importer reads 2.x and 3.x constructs side by side without validation.

cases.title: A 3.0.0 document without the required info object

input.text:
asyncapi: 3.0.0
channels:
  orders:
    address: orders.created
operations:
  sendOrderCreated:
    action: send
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/orders'

oracle.divergence_note: The parser rejects the document (Object must have required property "info"); the importer does not validate the info object.

cases.title: Control plus x-retry, x-idempotency-key, x-delivery and an idempotency header

input.text:
asyncapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Orders
  version: '1.0.0'
channels:
  orders:
    address: orders.created
    messages:
      OrderCreated:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/OrderCreated'
operations:
  sendOrderCreated:
    action: send
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/orders'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/orders/messages/OrderCreated'
    x-retry:
      max_attempts: 5
      backoff_ms: 200
    x-idempotency-key: message.header.idempotencyKey
    x-delivery: exactly-once
components:
  messages:
    OrderCreated:
      contentType: application/json
      headers:
        type: object
        required:
          - idempotencyKey
        properties:
          idempotencyKey:
            type: string
      payload:
        type: object
